QuestInfo.name: Slower than the Wind
QuestInfo.0: Cygnus wants to speak to you.
QuestInfo.1:
Cygnus wants to know if you've seen the #e#rRare Fire Flowers#k#n that bloom on the cliffs of Perion. #bGet her a flower.#k 

Tip: A single #rRare Fire Flower#k blooms along each of the cliffs of #bBig Rocky Road#k, #bRugged Rocky Zone#k, and #bGusty Peak#k.

Tip: You can return to Ereve using the #bImperial Recall#k skill, or you can take the boat at the #bVictoria Tree Platform#k above the Six Path Crossway.
QuestInfo.2: You went through all that hard work to get a flower for Cygnus, but Irena beat you to it.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1,900
#i2000018:# #t2000018:# x50
Can proceed to Evil Eyes in Ellinia

0.0: Mihile, your eyes are shining like I've never seen. The time away has clearly been kind to you. I am afraid I've called you here for my own personal reasons.
0.1: There is a flower that blooms in the Burnt Lands near Perion this time of year. It is called the Rare Fire Flower, and with it I can warm Ereve through the next winter.

no.0: It's a flower that rarely blooms. It makes sense that you may not have seen them.

0.2: I remember treasuring those flowers, since explorers had a hard time getting them. Mihile, have you seen those flowers?

0.msg: The flowers are very rare and wither quickly once they are cut. You can find them along the cliffs of the #bBig Rocky Road#k, #bRugged Rocky Zone#k, and #bGusty Peak#k.

1.msg: #b(Cygnus sounds like she really likes that flower. You should go find one, too.)#k

1.0: Ah, I-I'm sorry, Mihile. I couldn't get word to you in time, but Irena brought me a Fire Flower earlier. She said that she had heard I wanted one, so she put aside her training to get it. I hope you don't feel bad. I'll take yours as well. With the two of them, we will have more than enough heat!

yes.0: Thank you for giving your all, loyal knight...\r\n#b(What is Irena trying to pull here?)

item.0: They're not a flower commonly found near Perion. \r\nThe flowers are very rare and wither quickly once they are cut. You can find them along the cliffs of the #bBig Rocky Road#k, #bRugged Rocky Zone#k, and #bGusty Peak#k.
